newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Clorox estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Clorox estimates raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Carol Warner said in a Jan 21 report she raised the fiscal year 1997 estimate to $4.75 per share from $4.73 per share.
-- said raised fiscal year 1998 estimate to $5.45 per share from $5.40 per share.
-- said its second-quarter results, posted on Jan 16, maintained mid-double digit top line growth and were "outstanding."
-- Clorox last week posted second-quarter earnings of $0.85 per share compared to $0.73 per share last year, with sales up 14 percent to $530.2 million.
-- Clorox shares were up one to 111-3/4 on Thursday afternoon after hitting a new high of 112-5/8 earlier in the day on the New York Stock Exchange.
